rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) names the item; same-row captions and column headers used for Part III. Amounts pair the 11-slot peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right (money_joins). Part III date combs stay blank (three combs per row, one key). Keys with no printed cell: txtAtc and txtTaxTypeCode (preprinted WME10 and WE), txtLineBus (not printed), txtDate19-22 (multi-comb), txtAgency21 (no cell on row 21), txtFinalFlag, txtEnroll, ebirOnline*, driveSelectTPExport. The four TIN combs (p1c28, p1c30, p1c32, p1c34) are catalog-stamped by name-gaps.json and take no writer join. Since #113: Part III dates print through date_joins (one writer date split across the MM, DD and YYYY combs of its payment row); every other value has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
